title: 第13章 收服第14章 尊者大战
lines: 很快，一老者，和两位中年男子出现在了刚刚萧羽所在的地方，一无所获之后，三人便冷哼一声，各自选择了一个方向离去！
而其它的人，也注定一无所获。
萧羽不知道的是，落日山脉深处，一白衣女子发出一声轻啸，很快，三位姿色不一的女子出现在了白衣女子的面前。
“你们应该感觉到了吧？”白衣女子道。
“封禁在减弱！”一位女子柳眉轻皱道。
“少主终于出现了！通知妖鼠一族找到少主，将他带到这里，四妹办事不牢靠，二妹你去办！告诉妖鼠一族，事成之后，我会兑现承诺，给它3颗果子！”
“是，大姐！”
“哼，大姐，什么叫我办事不牢靠？二姐和三姐，忙于修炼，一直是我在和小老鼠们搜集消息好不好？“小姑娘很是不满的道。
白衣女子无奈的摇头：“你传回来的消息就是萧家那个废物少爷死而复生，大展神威，斩杀色魔？！我虽然也怜悯他之经历，可是此事怎能和找到少主相提并论？！”
“大姐，你怎知道，我们的少主就不可能是那个萧羽呢？要知道，老主人的夫君可是姓萧，这可是你亲口说的。”少女争辩道。
白衣女子一愣，随即弹了下少女的额头：“怎么可能？老主人可是星.....总之少主必定是一位天纵奇才，绝对不可能是一个废物！好了，如今少主出现，我们也该做好准备了，主人给我们的战衣也该穿上了！”
“是，大姐。"
“是，大姐。”
“可是，大姐那个盔甲太丑了！”少女嗔道
“好了，小妹，你还想不想出去了？”老二和老三一左一右的架起老四就走。因为她们发现白衣女子的脸色已经变了，再不走老四的皮肉之苦是少不了了！
萧羽此时正坐在一个树杈上，反复内视着自己的体内，不由得有些郁闷，这算怎么回事？
说好的灵武境呢？除了五个星核在滴溜溜的转，还有一个小到几乎可以忽略不记的丹田在体内瑟瑟发抖，吸纳来的灵气只有一小部分进入了丹田，其它的基本都被星核抢走了！
而且萧羽还发现星核似乎在不停的压缩着这些灵气！他现在是算灵武境还是聚气境呢？萧羽有些摸不着头脑。
此时的小刀也有些懵
“星族是不修丹田的，只修星核，难道这小子还继承了萧族的血脉之力？可是神族的血脉之力都太过于逆天，基本只能继承一个，可是这个丹田又怎么解释？”
“小刀，你说现在我算是什么实力？”萧羽问道
“聚气吧？聚气十重！”小刀道。
“好了，想那么多作甚？现在你的实力提升，我们继续向内探索。”小刀连忙岔开话题。
萧羽一路探索，倒是没有碰到什么强大的妖兽，2阶初期的对他来说已经没有什么威胁了，倒是击杀了几头，放在储物戒指里，不过也不是没有什么收获，灵药倒是采了几株。
“黑子，你怎么样了？坚持一下，我们一定会带你出去！”一个女的声音。
听着声音有些熟，萧羽慢慢的靠近了过去，拨开草丛发现前方有一个三人小队，一个男子奄奄一息的躺在一个简易的担架上，一个女子手持一张大弓在警戒，还有一个在安慰着受伤的男子。
“小姐，我不行了，你们快走吧！你们带着我是走不出去的，我们都会死在这里！”黑子道。
这时拿弓的女子走了过来“我们得尽快离开这里，我们身上的血腥味会引来妖兽，我们不能停留太久！”
萧羽看了一下，果然，这三人身上都带着伤，就是不知道是与人厮杀的还是与妖兽厮杀的。
“该死的李子豪和林磊，竟然为了追逐宝物，放弃了我们！”拿战锤的女子恨恨的道。
“他们两个估计凶多吉少了！”拿弓的女子低声道。
看到拿弓女子手上的箭，萧羽不由得裤裆一紧！那一箭是彻底给他留下阴影了，以至于以后只要有人敢拿箭射他，萧羽就会暴走！这是后话。
萧羽可不是什么大度的仁人君子，相反他对于自己守护的东西可是很计较的，尤其是二弟！正当萧羽准备趁火打劫的时候，萧羽发现另外一群人正在向这里靠近！
“嘿嘿，弟兄们运气不错，这里有两个负伤的小妞！”至于躺在那里的黑子，直接被忽略了，死人是不需要打招呼的！
领头的大汉，一双猥琐的眼睛不断的在两女的身上打量，同时身后的同伙发出了笑声”老大，你爽完，也别忘记了兄弟们啊！哈哈.。”
“找死！”手持战锤的女子，大怒。拎着战锤就向领头大汉的头上砸去，大汉也是不甘示弱，一把鬼头大刀就迎了上去。另外的几个男子，各持兵器向持弓女子杀去，持弓女子也是不断游走，拉开距离，对于弓手来说，近战并不是她的强项！
厮杀瞬间开始，而萧羽此时远远的看着，坐等渔翁之利！
本小章还未完，请点击下一页继续阅读后面精彩内容！
本来领头大汉是灵武境一重的实力，所以在他看来对付一个聚气九重的小丫头片子，应该是不费吹灰之力才对，可是交手之后才发现，这小丫头不仅没有被他压制，反而是他隐隐有被压制的趋势！双手更是被战锤震得酸麻！
“麻子过来帮忙，这是个硬点子！”大汉顾不得脸面，大吼道。
本来是被围攻的女子，看到一个人要去帮助大汉，立刻放弃了躲避，强行拉弓一箭向正准备转身脱离战圈的男子射去！
持弓女子后背防守出现了空档，另外3人，瞬间攻上，女子立刻从马靴中抽出一把短剑，转身抵挡！可是仍然有一剑斩在了女子的手臂上，女子发出了一声痛呼！瞬间鲜血涌出！
content_en:
Soon, an old man and two middle-aged men appeared where Xiao Yu was just now. After finding nothing, the three of them snorted and each chose a direction to leave!
And other people are destined to gain nothing.
What Xiao Yu didn't know was that deep in the Sunset Mountains, a woman in white let out a whistle, and soon, three women of different looks appeared in front of the woman in white.
"You should feel it, right?" the woman in white said.
"The ban is weakening!" A woman frowned slightly.
"The young master has finally appeared! Inform the demon rat clan to find the young master and bring him here. The fourth sister is not reliable in handling things. Second sister, you go and do it! Tell the demon rat clan that when the matter is completed, I will fulfill my promise and give it three fruits!"
"Yes, eldest sister!"
"Huh, eldest sister, why do you mean I'm not reliable? The second sister and the third sister are busy practicing, and I've been collecting information from the little mice, okay?" the little girl said very dissatisfied.
The woman in white shook her head helplessly: "The news you sent back is that the good-for-nothing young master of the Xiao family came back from the dead, showed off his power and killed the pervert?! Although I sympathize with his experience, how can this be compared with finding the young master?!"
"Sister, how do you know that our young master cannot be that Xiao Yu? You know, the old master's husband's surname is Xiao, and you said this yourself." The girl argued.
The woman in white was stunned for a moment, and then flicked the girl's forehead: "How is that possible? The old master is a star... In short, the young master must be a genius, and there is absolutely no way he is a waste! Well, now that the young master appears, we should be ready, and we should put on the battle clothes the master gave us!"
"Yes, eldest sister."
"Yes, eldest sister."
"But, sister, that armor is too ugly!" the girl said angrily.
"Okay, little sister, do you still want to go out?" The second and third children picked up the fourth child and left. Because they found that the face of the woman in white had changed, and if she didn't let the fourth child go, she would suffer a lot!
Xiao Yu was sitting on a tree branch at this time, looking inside his body repeatedly, and couldn't help but feel a little depressed, what's going on?
What about the promised Lingwu realm? In addition to the five star cores spinning slowly, there is also a Dantian that is so small that it can almost be ignored and trembles in the body. Only a small part of the absorbed spiritual energy enters the Dantian, and the rest is basically taken away by the star core!
Moreover, Xiao Yu also discovered that the star core seemed to be constantly compressing the spiritual energy! Is he currently in the Lingwu realm or the Qi gathering realm? Xiao Yu was a little confused.
At this time, Xiaodao was also a little confused.
"The Star Clan does not cultivate the dantian, but only cultivates the star core. Could it be that this boy has inherited the power of the Xiao Clan's bloodline? However, the power of the bloodline of the God Clan is too heaven-defying, and basically only one can be inherited. But how to explain this dantian?"
"Xiao Dao, what kind of strength do you think I am now?" Xiao Yu asked
"Gathering Qi, right? Gathering Qi at the tenth level!" Xiao Dao said.
Xiao Yu "..."
"Okay, why are you thinking so much? Now that your strength has improved, let's continue to explore inward." Xiaodao quickly changed the subject.
Xiao Yu explored all the way, but did not encounter any powerful monsters. Those at the early stage of level 2 were no longer a threat to him. He did kill a few and put them in the storage ring. However, it was not without harvest. He collected a few elixirs.
"Heizi, how are you? Hold on, we will definitely take you out!" A female voice said.
Hearing that the voice sounded familiar, Xiao Yu slowly approached and pushed aside the grass to find a team of three people in front of them. A man was lying dying on a simple stretcher, a woman was on guard with a big bow, and another was comforting the injured man.
"Miss, I can't do it anymore. You should leave quickly! You can't get out with me. We will all die here!" Heizi said.
At this time, the woman holding the bow came over and said, "We have to leave here as soon as possible. The smell of blood on our bodies will attract monsters. We can't stay too long!"
Xiao Yu took a look, and sure enough, these three people were all injured, but he didn't know whether they were from fighting with humans or monsters.
"Damn Li Zihao and Lin Lei, they gave up on us just to chase the treasure!" the woman holding the war hammer said bitterly.
"The two of them are probably in danger!" the woman holding the bow whispered.
Seeing the arrow in the woman holding the bow, Xiao Yu couldn't help but tighten his crotch! That arrow completely left a shadow on him, so that whenever anyone dared to shoot him with an arrow in the future, Xiao Yu would go berserk! This is something to talk about later.
Xiao Yu is not a generous and benevolent gentleman. On the contrary, he is very careful about the things he protects, especially his second brother! Just when Xiao Yu was about to take advantage of the situation, Xiao Yu discovered that another group of people were approaching here!
"Hey, brothers, you are lucky, there are two injured girls here!" As for the black man lying there, he was simply ignored. The dead do not need to say hello!
The leading man kept looking at the two women with his wretched eyes. At the same time, his accomplices behind him laughed, "Boss, after you're done, don't forget your brothers! Haha..."
"Seeking death!" The woman holding a war hammer was furious. He picked up the war hammer and smashed it on the head of the leading big man. Not to be outdone, the big man faced him with a ghost-headed sword. Several other men, each armed with weapons, attacked the woman with the bow. The woman with the bow kept wandering away to keep the distance. For the archer, close combat was not her strong point!
The fighting started instantly, and Xiao Yu was watching from a distance, waiting for his advantage!

Originally, the leading man was at the first level of the Spiritual Martial Realm, so in his opinion, it should be effortless to deal with a little girl at the ninth level of Qi Gathering. However, after the fight, he discovered that not only was the little girl not suppressed by him, but he had a faint tendency to be suppressed! His hands were even numb from the shock of the war hammer!
"Mazi, come here and help, this is a tough idea!" The big man yelled without caring about his face.
The woman who was originally being besieged saw a man going to help the big man, so she immediately gave up hiding, forcibly drew her bow and shot an arrow at the man who was about to turn around and leave the ring!
There was a gap in the back defense of the woman holding the bow. The other three people attacked instantly. The woman immediately pulled out a short sword from her riding boots and turned around to resist! But there was still a sword slashed on the woman's arm, and the woman let out a cry of pain! Blood gushes out instantly!
